name: What are the first steps to take when planning to build a new home?

mainEntity.name: What are the first steps to take when planning to build a new home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The initial steps for new home construction involve defining your budget, securing financing, and identifying a suitable lot if you don't already own one. Next, it's crucial to select a reputable general contractor and work with an architect or designer to create a custom home plan that meets your needs and local zoning regulations. Permitting applications follow, which can be a lengthy process. Our team can guide you through each of these critical early stages to ensure a smooth start.
acceptedAnswer.description: First steps include budgeting, financing, lot selection, choosing a contractor, and designing your home plan before applying for permits.
